primitives.note: Spinning Axe arms Draven's next basic attack to deal bonus physical damage (base + % bonus AD).
Draven can hold up to two armed Spinning Axes (charges) at once via recast/catch, each empowering a future basic attack.
The empowered attack's bonus damage is dealt as a single instance of basic attack damage, so it benefits from crit and on-hit multipliers like a normal auto.
Blood Rush grants bonus attack speed for 3s on cast.
Catching a Spinning Axe resets Blood Rush's cooldown, allowing more frequent attack-speed windows.
Stand Aside deals a fixed-cast-time (0.25s) physical damage nuke on cooldown.
Whirling Death has an outbound pass and a manually- or automatically-triggered return pass, each dealing its own instance of physical damage with independent falloff.
Assumes the stationary dummy is hit by both the outbound and return pass of R (single-target line fight), and assumes whether/how often Draven catches his own thrown Spinning Axes.
R executes enemy champions damaged to or below a health threshold equal to Draven's current League of Draven (Adoration) stacks.
The execute threshold scales with Draven's permanent Adoration stack count, which is external to the fight and must be assumed.
Mana costs on all four abilities (45/20-40/70/100) can gate how often each is cast inside the 15s window.

needsBespoke.why: Draven's kit maps onto empowered-attack (Q), an ammo-like charge system (Q's two-axe hold), timed-self-buff and cooldown-manipulation (W), plain-cast (E), and a recast-or-multipart execute ability (R) with an infinite-scaling threshold. The unusual 'catch the axe' and 'return-pass axes' mechanics are geometry/positional assumptions the fight must fix, not logic the primitive list cannot express.

unsettled.question: Does the single-dummy damage fight assume Draven catches his own thrown Spinning Axes (and Whirling Death's return pass), enabling continuous Q re-arming, Blood Rush cooldown resets, and a second R damage instance on the same target?
options: Assume Draven always catches axes / R always returns through the dummy, maximizing uptime
Assume no catching occurs (axes simply expire), so Q and R only ever deal one hit per cast
quotes: Whenever a {{ai|Spinning Axe|Draven}} is caught, ''Blood Rush's'' cooldown will {{sti|ah|reset}}.
''Enemies can be hit only once per pass.''

options: Use the DravenDoubleShot bin cooldown 18 to 14

unsettled.question: What Adoration stack count should be assumed for Whirling Death's execute threshold in the damage fight against a full-health dummy?
options: Assume 0 stacks (execute never fires, ignore the mechanic for damage purposes)
Assume some representative mid-game stack count (e.g. 20-50) that could meaningfully execute the dummy near its death threshold
quotes: Enemy {{tip|champions}} that are damaged to or while below a {{sti|{{as|health}}}} threshold equal to the number of ''{{ai|League of Draven|Draven|Adoration}}'' stacks are {{tip|execute|executed}}.

unsettled.question: Does recasting Whirling Death's return pass happen automatically at the earliest opportunity (1s after outbound) for maximum DPS, or is there a reason a player would delay/never recast it in an optimal-damage rotation?
options: Recast immediately at the 1s minimum for a guaranteed second damage instance
Let it travel to max range/reverse naturally, delaying the second hit
quotes: ''Whirling Death'' can be recast after 1 second while the axes are traveling, and does so automatically after the axes hit an enemy {{tip|champion}} or the edge of the [[Map (League of Legends)|map]].

proposal: Pre-combat: cast Q (Spinning Axe, no cast time) to arm the next basic attack with bonus physical damage.
Open with an auto-attack to consume the armed Q for its bonus damage, then immediately cast W (Blood Rush) for bonus attack speed.
Cast R (Whirling Death) early to send the axes through the dummy for physical damage, then recast it after 1s so the return pass hits the dummy again for a second damage instance.
Cast E (Stand Aside) as soon as it is off cooldown for its physical damage nuke.
Recast Q every time it comes off cooldown (or when an axe is assumed caught) to keep an empowered attack ready for the next auto-attack, and keep auto-attacking continuously in between casts.
Recast W again once its 12s cooldown is up (or sooner if a Q catch is assumed to reset it) to refresh the attack-speed window for the remainder of the fight.
Recast E again once off cooldown near the end of the 15s window.
Fill all remaining time with continuous basic attacks, since auto-attacks (empowered by Q, accelerated by W) are Draven's main damage source over 15 seconds.
questions: Should the fight assume Draven successfully catches every Spinning Axe he throws, and does the simulator model a 'catch' event at all for a single stationary dummy?
Is Whirling Death cast once or twice within the 15s window given its long cooldown (80-100s), and should its recast (return pass) always be taken at the earliest 1s mark for maximum DPS?
Which E cooldown value (16-12 vs 18-14) is actually live in the current patch, since it changes how many times Stand Aside can be cast in 15s?
Is there a meaningful assumed Adoration stack count for the execute part of R against a target dummy, or should the execute be ignored entirely for damage-race purposes?
